description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
